svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Output-stationary tiled GEMM
One trigger runs the whole product. Highlighted: output tile (mt=2, nt=3) being accumulated over all 8 K tiles.
A 32 x 32 INT8, drawn as its 8 x 8 tile grid
each cell is one 4x4 tile
mt=2
B 32 x 32 INT8, 8 x 8 tiles
nt=3
C = A B 32 x 32 INT32, 8 x 8 tiles
this tile stays in acc_bank
x
What gemm_sequencer runs
for mt in 0 .. 7:
for nt in 0 .. 7:
acc_bank <= 0
for kt in 0 .. 7:
fetch A tile (mt, kt) 4 reads from store A
fetch B tile (kt, nt) 4 reads from store B
launch engine, wait for valid
acc_bank += A tile x B tile
write acc_bank to store C (mt, nt) 4 writes
Why output stationary
The 4x4 accumulator tile is written once per output tile position,
not once per K tile. 8 partial products are summed in place, so no
partial sum ever leaves the accumulator registers.
Each A tile is fetched 8 times (once per nt) and each B tile 8 times
(once per mt). That reuse is the price paid for keeping C resident.
Operand traffic per run: 2048 A word reads + 2048 B word reads
Result traffic per run: 256 C word writes
Total MACs: 32768
Generated by tools/svg_dataflow.py from the same geometry parameters as rtl/pkg/gemm_pkg.sv
